[Problem]{.card-kicker} **minutes until the infection covers the tree** [LC 2385 · Amount of Time for Binary Tree to Be Infected](https://leetcode.com/problems/amount-of-time-for-binary-tree-to-be-infected/){difficulty="Medium"}

After you know each node's parent, the tree is an undirected graph of degree at most $3$. The minute a node is infected is its distance from `start`. Spreading only downward misses the parent and returns $1$ on the sample whose answer is $4$.

[Solved in full in @sec-tr-p6-infect.]{.card-link}
